title: Span-Native Governance, version 0.1: the envelope of a record
description: What every governance record has, whatever its specification, in the logical JSON form of the specifications: a resource naming the specification it follows, an identity, a time, a status, attributes, and links with a governance relation. Each specification's own schema adds its attributes. Copyright (c) 2022 Nitro Agility S.r.l. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

resource.description: The producer's resource. A record's specification is named by its version attribute, `<prefix>.version`.

context.description: The identity of the record: the same trace id and span id are the same record.

end_time.description: The time of the record: when the operation ended, or the fact became true.

ogs.link.relation.description: The governance relation of the link: supersedes, evidence, approves, caused_by, or one a specification defines under its own prefix.
